# apple_ci_workflows (Data Source)

Lists the workflows of an Xcode Cloud product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_workflows" "product" {
  product_id = data.apple_ci_products.app.products[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode Cloud product; see `data.apple_ci_products`.

### Read-Only

- `workflows` (Attributes List) The workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows))

<a id="nestedatt--workflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the workflow.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow starts builds.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the workflow.
- `name` (String) Name of the workflow.
